description: Take a 60-second typing test on a random paragraph. Live per-character feedback, then your words-per-minute score and accuracy.

faqs.a: One “word” counts as 5 characters. Your net WPM is (correct characters ÷ 5) ÷ minutes, so errors lower your score.
Around 40 WPM is average, 60+ is good, and 80+ is fast. Professional typists often exceed 100 WPM.
faqs.q: What is a good typing speed?

faqs.a: No — pasting is blocked in the typing box, so every score is genuinely typed.
faqs.q: Can I cheat by pasting the text?

howto: Click “New Test” to get a random paragraph, or just start typing.
The 60-second timer starts automatically on your first keystroke.
Type into the box — correct letters turn green, mistakes turn red as you go.
When time runs out (or you finish the paragraph), you'll see your WPM score and accuracy.
title: Typing Speed Test
